# ArkConfigProvider
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/ArkConfigProvider.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IArkConfigProvider](../interfaces/i-ark-config-provider.md), [ArkAccessManaged](./ark-access-managed.md), ConfigurationManaged

**Title:**
ArkConfigProvider

**Author:**
SummerFi

This contract manages the configuration for Ark contracts.

Inherits from IArkConfigProvider, ArkAccessManaged, and ConfigurationManaged.

**Note:**
see: IArkConfigProvider


## State Variables
### config

```solidity
ArkConfig public config
```

Initializes the ArkConfigProvider contract.

Validates input parameters and sets up the initial configuration.

```solidity
    ConfigurationManaged(_params.configurationManager);
```
